Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cohortflow 0.0.0.9016

Breaking changes

  • CONSORT diagrams put every number beside text that describes those people. An uncategorised exclude() or group_exclude() step’s label now appears in its exclusion box with the number removed (“Withdrew consent (n=4)”), and the main box below it reads “Remaining (n=118)”. Previously the main box showed “Withdrew consent (n=118)”, which read as 118 withdrawals. The new remaining_label argument changes that text. include()-type steps keep their label on the main box.
  • count_by now counts distinct units in every box and row, not only the arm boxes and columns. In as_attrition_tibble(), as_attrition_table() and as_consort_diagram(), n, n_removed and the percentages all count units, so a crossover trial reports participants throughout instead of participant-periods in the trunk and participants in the arms. A unit counts as removed at the step where it loses its last row. count_by must name a level of the flow’s hierarchy (a level name, or the column of a single-column level), so the flow needs apply_criteria(hierarchy = ). Old calls without a hierarchy, or naming a column that is not a level, fail with an error (class cohortflow_count_by_hierarchy) that explains the change and shows the cf_hierarchy() call to add.

New features

  • include(), exclude(), group_include(), group_exclude(), select_within() and cf_criterion() gain reason: a description of the rows the step removes (“Under 18” for include(~ age >= 18, "Aged 18 or over")). Diagram exclusion boxes use it. Exclusion steps default to their label. An inclusion step without one gets an exclusion box that says “Excluded”. If it is listed in a category’s exclusion box, its label is used and as_consort_diagram() warns (class cohortflow_missing_reason, at most every 8 hours; options(cohortflow.warn_missing_reason = FALSE) turns it off). reason is printed with the pipeline and round-trips through export_criteria() / import_criteria(); it is written only when set, so other files are unchanged. Flows built before reason existed still draw.
  • count_by no longer requires branch_by, and works with a randomise() split (each arm’s cascade counts the same units as the trunk).

Better messages for old usage

  • A step selector such as steps = c(0, "Consented") turns 0 into the text "0", which matches no step. The error now says so and suggests list(0, "Consented"). This applies wherever steps are selected (cohort(), excluded(), as_characteristics_tibble(), stack_cohorts()). A step labelled "1" still resolves by label.
  • import_criteria() warns (class cohortflow_legacy_yaml) when a file uses the pre-0.0.0.9011 fn_args format, naming the step, explaining that default argument values were not stored, and giving the call to re-save the file. A file with a schema version newer than 1 is refused with a message to update the package, instead of being misread.
  • The mock_cohortflow() deprecation warning lists which generator suits which design, and has class cohortflow_deprecated.

cohortflow 0.0.0.9015

Documentation

  • New package website at https://mattmoo.github.io/cohortflow/, with a reference index grouped by task and eight articles.
  • Three vignettes: “Get started”, “Writing criteria” (including a worked example of how include() and exclude() treat missing values) and “Hierarchical and cluster designs”.
  • Web-only articles: “Attrition tables”, “CONSORT diagrams”, “Staged pipelines and missing units”, “Describing who was excluded” and a “Study design gallery” covering parallel, crossover, cluster and stepped-wedge trials.
  • Reference pages cross-link related functions, and export_criteria(), import_criteria(), plot.cf_flow() and print.consort_diagram() gain examples.

Bug fixes

  • as_consort_diagram(stage_by = ) no longer draws stage boxes on top of each other. Stages (e.g. crossover periods) now stack below their branch box with the same gap as the rest of the diagram, and a wrapped label pushes later stages down instead of overlapping them.
  • The gt backend of as_attrition_table() and as_characteristics_table() now leaves empty cells blank, as flextable and huxtable do. Previously it printed NA in the header row’s removed count and in every arm column above the final row.
  • as_attrition_table(levels = NULL) now shows every hierarchy level, as documented and as as_attrition_tibble(levels = NULL) does. Previously it failed with an internal subsetting error.

cohortflow 0.0.0.9014

New features

  • excluded() gains only = FALSE. With only = TRUE it returns just the rows removed at the selected step, rather than every row removed up to and including it: excluded(flow, at = 2, only = TRUE).

cohortflow 0.0.0.9013

New features

  • save_consort_diagram() writes a CONSORT diagram (or a cf_flow, drawn with default settings) to PNG, TIFF, JPEG, PDF, SVG or EPS, choosing the format from the file extension. Defaults suit manuscript submission: 300 dpi, a white background, ragg devices for raster output when installed, cairo_pdf() for PDF (embeds fonts), and svglite for SVG when installed. When width and height are omitted the page size comes from the diagram layout, so box text fits its boxes and longer pipelines give taller files; supplying one dimension keeps the aspect ratio.

Bug fixes

  • as_attrition_table() now shows every percentage to digits decimal places, keeping trailing zeros: a 10% removal reads 10.0% rather than 10%, and the final row 90.0% included. This applies to plain, group_x/group_y and levels = tables, matching as_consort_diagram().

cohortflow 0.0.0.9012

New features

  • as_characteristics_tibble() and as_characteristics_table() build a step-wise baseline-characteristics (“Table 1”) table: variables as rows, one column per criteria step, each cell summarising the cohort surviving up to and including that step (cohort(flow, step_number = k)). Numeric variables show mean (SD) and/or median [Q1, Q3]; factor, character and logical variables show n (%); each variable gets a missing-values row. steps = takes the same selectors as cohort() to restrict or reorder the columns, excluded = TRUE describes the rows removed at each step instead, and level = summarises one row per hierarchy unit. The table renders through the same flextable, gt and huxtable backends as as_attrition_table().
  • stack_cohorts() returns the per-step cohorts stacked with a step factor, ready for gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = step).

cohortflow 0.0.0.9011

Smoke-test fixes

  • Error messages from cf_criterion() and the criterion evaluators no longer show raw markup such as {.arg label}; they now include the actual label, class, lengths and missing column names.
  • Per-level hierarchy counts (as_attrition_tibble(levels = ), as_attrition_table(levels = )) no longer count an NA key as a unit. For example, an expected participant with no cluster counts as one participant and zero clusters, not as an extra “phantom” cluster.
  • The .data and .env pronouns now work in include(), exclude() and select_within() formulas, as they already did in grouped steps and as check_criteria() assumed.
  • export_criteria() no longer errors on a primitive-function predicate such as include(is.na, ...). Such predicates now print as .Primitive("is.na") rather than NULL.
  • as_attrition_tibble(), as_attrition_table() and as_consort_diagram() now give a clear error (“branch_by must be a single column name.”) when branch_by, count_by, stage_by, stage_label_by, group_x or group_y is not a single column name. Previously this failed with an R internals error.
  • as_consort_diagram() now draws a plain linear cascade when no rows reach the branch point (a zero-row flow, or every row excluded before randomise()). Previously it warned, or with branch_by failed.
  • A row-wise predicate in group_include() / group_exclude() (e.g. ~ age > 18) now gives “Group criterion”

Audit fixes

  • NA values in branch_by / stage_by (including randomise() arms) now form their own branch, labelled by the new branch_na_label argument (default "Missing") of as_attrition_tibble(), as_attrition_table() and as_consort_diagram(). Previously they were counted in every branch.
  • apply_criteria() now aborts (instead of warning) when the row identifier (id, single or composite, or a pre-existing .cf_row_id) has duplicate or NA values, which silently corrupted cohort() / excluded().
  • Group predicates must return a logical .pass, the by column(s), and exactly one row per group; anything else now aborts.
  • Rows with an NA in any by column are removed by every grouped step type (group_exclude() used to keep them).
  • as_attrition_table() gains group_na_label.
  • Function predicates print their body rather than x$predicate.
  • export_criteria() stores the full function source, so default argument values survive a YAML round-trip; the fn_args field is dropped (old files still import). It now returns the YAML visibly when path = NULL. import_criteria() documents that criteria files contain executable code.
  • A warning is issued when a category’s steps are not consecutive.
  • CONSORT boxes are spaced by their content, so long pipelines and tall exclusion boxes no longer overlap.
  • Zero-row flows no longer show NaN% included.
  • branch_by values that clash with standard column names (e.g. "n") abort.
  • The always-NA branch column is removed from as_attrition_tibble() output.
  • cf_criterion() aborts when by is given for include / exclude; as_consort_diagram() aborts when count_by is given without branch_by.
  • mock_cohortflow() warns once per session.

New features

  • cohort() and excluded() can stop at an intermediate step, returning the rows surviving (or removed) up to and including it. Select the step with step_number (0 = starting data), label, or category (last step in that category); or use at, which auto-selects (number, else label, else category). At most one selector may be given. With cohort(flag = TRUE), attribution only covers steps up to the chosen step.

  • New criteria_status() returns one row per data row and one logical column per criterion, for auditing who failed what and for set/overlap plots of exclusion reasons. mode = "cumulative" follows the cascade (FALSE at the removing step, NA = not assessed afterwards); mode = "independent" evaluates every criterion on the full data. Options cover failure sets (sets = "fail"), NA handling (na = "keep"/"false"/"drop"), column naming, keep_data, and output as a tibble, data.table or logical matrix. data.table is a new suggested package.

  • New check_criteria(criteria, data) checks before evaluation that every formula predicate, by and arms refers only to columns in data, and aborts naming each offending step’s number, label and missing column(s). apply_criteria() and continue_criteria() run it automatically, so a forgotten join in a staged pipeline now fails up front instead of with object 'x' not found inside evaluation. Names bound in the formula’s environment are allowed; function predicates are not checked.

  • cf_flow objects record the id column(s) passed to apply_criteria() (older flow objects still work).

  • ?include / ?exclude document how a predicate that evaluates to NA is handled: include() removes the row, exclude() keeps it.

  • as_attrition_table() gained a levels argument, mirroring as_attrition_tibble(levels = ): it renders one row per criterion with a column block (N / Removed / % removed) per hierarchy level, so a single row reports its effect at both the unit of analysis and the unit of recruitment (e.g. participants and clusters) side by side. This is the reporting form required by the CONSORT cluster extension (Campbell, Elbourne & Altman, BMJ 2004;328:702-8) and the within-person extension. New level_labels argument supplies display names for the column blocks (level names are otherwise used as-is, unmangled). A show_consequential argument adds an optional fourth column per level for units lost only because a group_include()/group_exclude() group they belonged to was removed; by default it appears only when populated. levels cannot be combined with group_x/group_y/branch_by/count_by. Shading (shade/shade_fn) is computed per level.
